task.name: Set_up_communal_kitchen
task.when: During Build after the kitchen footprint is approved

step.action: Confirm the current kitchen layout, carport instructions, inventory, anchor plan, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
Mark the kitchen footprint without blocking a service lane or emergency exit.
Install the ground covering shown in the kitchen layout.
Assemble and anchor the kitchen carport according to its manufacturer instructions and anchor plan.
Place and stabilize the cooking, washing, storage, and eating tables shown in the layout.
Place food, handwashing, fresh-water, gray-water, trash, and cleaning stations in their mapped positions.
Have the Food Lead compare the completed kitchen with the final-state photograph.

passWhen.criterion: The kitchen matches the current layout and final-state photograph.
The carport and every required anchor are installed.
Every table is stable and each station is in its mapped position.
Service lanes and emergency exits are clear.
The Food Lead completed the final inspection.

reasoning.entry: Propane, potable-water, and electrical connections remain separate authorized tasks.
